purpose: region 4 mechanized aristocrats city, three-stage battle backgrounds

jobs.brief: EARLY: Private lift arrival and gated service entrance. At left-center a tall elegant ivory-and-brass lift landing gate with large curved fan-shaped metal ribs and two substantial counterweight housings. A small orderly parcel alcove with sealed unmarked cases and a service hatch is recessed well BEHIND the floor, next to the gate. Beyond it, several staggered immaculate residential facades with a handful of warm occupied windows and private supply conduits. Architectural inequality: small worker access at far left, grand sealed gate and well-supplied homes behind. Gate base and counterweight housings visible in the battle crop, quiet right-side depths. More utilitarian than the later stages, but clearly wealthy.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production pixel-art battle environment for ORVASK, FOURTH DISTRICT: the secluded CITY OF MECHANIZED ARISTOCRATS inside a vast dystopian climate-control tower. Input1 approved original world style: broad stepped architecture, quiet color masses, no noisy surface detail. Input2 approved later background: match pixel cluster density and scale, NOT its plants/water or architecture. Input3 actual game viewport COMPOSITION ONLY: never copy people, enemies, cards, words or UI.
This is an inhabited privileged city above deprived districts: PRIVATE taste, elegant asymmetrical houses, refined ivory ceramic over industrial brass mechanisms, traces of mechanical-body maintenance infrastructure. Not a medieval fantasy castle, not a military citadel, not cyberpunk neon. Beauty and controlled access, subtle dystopia. Tower architecture continues into hazy interior heights; no outdoor sky.
COHESION: muted slate blue, gray violet, aged ivory stone, restrained tarnished brass and warm amber windows. Broad grouped shadows, painterly PIXEL CLUSTERS with 5–10px-looking stepped edges on a 1672x941 canvas, same density as reference. No smooth illustration, blur, grain, dithering, tiny filigree, scattered sparkles or razor sharp black outlines. Show luxury with proportions and materials, not dense decoration.
LOCK GAME GEOMETRY: wide 1672x941, SINGLE perfectly level side-on raised promenade across whole width, top foot contact y720. Front dark steel/gunmetal trim with a narrow stone upper edge, supporting beams below. One low quiet rail BEHIND it. Nothing on or in front of the walkable floor. No stairs/obstacles/gaps on the playing plane. Hero stands near x10%; enemies x45–96%. Keep x42–96% y420–715 calm medium-dark broad wall/atmospheric masses to show actors and HP. Avoid brightest lamps/ivory windows in that actor band.
Actual game crops approximately source y430–820, wide screens y520–790. Main district storytelling MUST remain visible here: doors, bases of elegant houses, lift shafts, private supply machinery. Do not put all identifying features above y400. Leftmost x0–260 needs a modest service doorway and small warm lamp behind the hero, not a shack and not a second character. Foreground/midground/distant layers; tremendous interior scale. No people, robots, creatures, statues shaped as people, text, glyph labels, logos, UI or watermarks. Opaque.

jobs.brief: MIDDLE: The aristocrats' residential promenade. Three differing immense elegant bay-windowed residences step away into the background. One left-center curved glass-fronted prosthetic atelier with a CLOSED tall ceramic door, empty articulated maintenance arm folded in a recessed window bay, a small lit display alcove holding a SINGLE detached elegant metal forearm (object, not person). Distinct curved balconies and brass elevator trunks integrated into the houses. A muted burgundy awning high on left and two low clipped plants tucked behind stone parapets signal deliberate luxury, not abandoned vines. Broad ivory bases and amber lower windows should remain visible in y500–700; soft slate/violet right-side facades behind enemies. No all-over ornaments. A prosperous private street inside the tower, not a shop UI or interior room.

jobs.brief: LATE: The approach to a noble family's reception residence, NOT the final ruler's throne room. Left-center a massive closed oval fan-ribbed bronze entrance framed in aged ivory ceramic; layered asymmetric terraces and a great ornamental mechanical ring integrated into the façade above. Two restrained draped burgundy fabric panels flank the entrance, blank with no words. Private power collectors and a visible quiet lift shaft connect to receding tall residential towers behind. Gate bottom, heavy ivory plinths and elegant unlit reception windows visible in battle crop y450–710. More imposing and secluded than middle street, using muted warm brass against deep slate-violet mist. Right half quiet shaded colonnade and atmospheric urban depth for boss and escorts. No throne, no occupant, no final command device, no crowded gear motifs.
